周六下午五点四十。

黄浦区海澜阁。

林川把宾利停正门。

今天换了身藏青色羊绒衫搭深灰休闲裤，脚上一双BerlUti的麂皮鞋。

推门进包间的时候，一桌人已经坐齐了。

张虎坐在靠门那侧，腰板挺得笔直。

但右手在桌下反复搓大腿，搓得裤子布料都快起毛了。

他今天换了身新衣服。

浅蓝色衬衫，领口的扣子系到最上面那颗，脖子勒得脸都红了——那条假金链子终于摘了。

宋清坐在他旁边，偶尔侧身跟他说句话，声音压得很低。

主位是宋清父亲宋建国。五十出头，头发梳得一丝不苟，

戴一副银框眼镜，面前的茶杯摆得端端正正。

坐姿标准得像开大会。

宋清母亲刘玉芬坐在宋建国右手边。

手里转着茶杯盖，眼睛时不时扫一眼张虎的领口和袖扣，没说话，嘴角往下压着。

斜对面坐着一个三十岁左右的男人。

藏蓝色RalphLaUrenpOlO衫，袖口翻了两折，露出一块浪琴。

发型打理得很精致，坐姿往后靠着，一条胳膊搭在椅背上。

周凯。

林川推门那一刻，周凯正在说话。

“……所以我跟张虎说的，不是打击谁。做外贸代理，赚的是信息差的钱。但信息差是会消失的。你今天能接到义乌的单子，明天换个人一样能接。真正有壁垒的是什么？是体系，是平台给你的背书。”

他语气平和，甚至带着善意。

但每个字都精准地踩在张虎的短板上。

张虎握着茶杯，笑容僵在脸上，嘴唇动了两下没发出声。

宋清正要开口，林川已经走到桌边了。

“不好意思，路上堵了几分钟。”

张虎猛地站起来，动作快得椅子往后滑了半尺。

“川子！”

一嗓子喊出来，整个人的状态肉眼可见地松了。

宋清跟着起身。

第一次近距离看到林川——比张虎描述的还年轻。

但眼神里那股沉稳，不像二十出头的人。

“宋老师好。”林川先招呼她，然后转向主位。

“宋叔，刘阿姨，我是林川。张虎的朋友，也是他的合伙人。今天来得唐突，先敬一杯茶。”

他端起桌上的茶壶，给宋建国和刘玉芬各倒了一杯。

动作自然，没有刻意讨好，也没有端着。

宋建国看了他一眼，点了下头。“你好。”

周凯站起来伸出手。“你好，我是宋清的表哥，周凯。IBM大中华区。”

自我介绍里嵌品牌，标准的外企社交开场白。

林川握了一下，力道适中。

“做哪个方向的？”

“企业级解决方案。”周凯笑了笑，“主要对接长三角的大客户。”

“不错。”

林川坐下来，没追问。

Saturday at 5:40 p.m.

Hailan Pavilion, Huangpu District.

Lin Chuan parked the Bentley at the front door.

Today I changed into a navy cashmere sweater, dark gray casual pants, and a pair of BerlUti suede shoes.

When I opened the door and entered the private room, a table of people was already seated.

Zhang Hu sat on the side near the door, his back straight.

But he rubbed his thigh repeatedly with his right hand under the table until the fabric of his pants almost became fluffy.

He changed into new clothes today.

He was wearing a light blue shirt, with the collar button tied to the top button, and his neck was so tight that his face turned red - the fake gold chain was finally taken off.

Song Qing sat next to him, occasionally turning sideways and speaking to him in a low voice.

The main person is Song Jianguo, the father of Song Qing Dynasty.He is in his early fifties, his hair is meticulously combed,

Wearing a pair of silver-framed glasses, the teacup is placed neatly in front of him.

The sitting posture is as standard as a meeting.

Song Qing's mother Liu Yufen sits on the right hand side of Song Jianguo.

He turned the lid of the teacup in his hand and glanced at Zhang Hu's collar and cufflinks from time to time. He said nothing and kept the corners of his mouth pressed down.

Sitting diagonally opposite was a man of about thirty years old.

Navy blue Ralph La UrenpOlO shirt, the cuffs are folded in half, revealing a piece of Longines.

Her hair was neatly styled, and she was sitting leaning back with one arm resting on the back of the chair.

Zhou Kai.

The moment Lin Chuan opened the door, Zhou Kai was talking.

"...So what I told Zhang Hu is not to attack anyone. As a foreign trade agent, you earn money with poor information. But the information gap will disappear. You can get an order from Yiwu today, and someone else can pick it up tomorrow. What are the real barriers? It's the system, and the endorsement given to you by the platform."

His tone was calm, even kind.

But every word accurately hits Zhang Hu's shortcomings.

Zhang Hu held the tea cup, his smile froze on his face, his lips moved twice without making a sound.

Just as Song Qing was about to speak, Lin Chuan had already walked to the table.

"Sorry, we were stuck in traffic for a few minutes."

Zhang Hu stood up suddenly, so fast that his chair slid back half a foot.

"Kawako!"

He shouted out loud, and his whole body relaxed visibly.

Song Qing stood up.

It was the first time I saw Lin Chuan up close - he was younger than Zhang Hu described.

But the calmness in his eyes was unlike that of someone in his early twenties.

"Hello, Teacher Song." Lin Chuan greeted her first, and then turned to the main seat.

"Uncle Song, Aunt Liu, I'm Lin Chuan. Zhang Hu's friend is also his partner. I'm here unexpectedly today, so I'd like to propose a cup of tea first."

He picked up the teapot on the table and poured a cup each for Song Jianguo and Liu Yufen.

The movements were natural, not trying to please or holding back.

Song Jianguo glanced at him and nodded."Hello."

Zhou Kai stood up and stretched out his hand."Hello, I am Song Qing's cousin, Zhou Kai. IBM Greater China."

Embed the brand in the self-introduction, a standard social opening for foreign companies.

Lin Chuan shook it with moderate strength.

"Which direction are you doing?"

"Enterprise-level solutions." Zhou Kai smiled, "Mainly connecting with large customers in the Yangtze River Delta."

"Not bad."

Lin Chuan sat down and didn't ask any further questions.
